neurons, act) {\n      if (layers === 0 || act === 'linear') {\n        return 0.25 * x + 0.05;\n      }\n      const capacity = layers * neurons;\n      if (act === 'relu') {\n        const segments = Math.min(28, Math.max(2, Math.floor(capacity * 0.75)));\n        const minX = -3, maxX = 3;\n        const step = (maxX - minX) / segments;\n        const idx = Math.floor((x - minX) / step);\n        const x0 = minX + idx * step;\n        const x1 = x0 + step;\n        const t = (x - x0) / step;\n        const damping = Math.min(1, 0.45 + capacity / 28);\n        const y0 = trueFunc(x0) * else {\n        params = (1 * N + N) + (L - 1) * (N * N + N) + (N * 1 + 1);\n      }\n      paramCount.textContent = params;\n\n      let sumSq = 0;\n      const steps = 100;\n      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {\n        const x = -3 + (6 * i) / steps;\n        const d = trueFunc(x) - computeApproximation(x, L, N, state.activation);\n        sumSq += d * d;\n      }\n      const mse = sumSq / (steps + 1);\n      mseVal.textContent = mse.toFixed(3);\n\n      if (L === 0) {\n        insightText.textContent = \"0 Hidden Layers: The network is just simple linear regression (y = Wx + b).\";\n        mathExpr.textContent = \"f(x) = W₁x + b₁\";\n      } else if (state.activation === 'linear') {\n        insightText.textContent = \"Linear Activation: Stacking layers without non-linearity collapses back into a straight line!\";\n        mathExpr.textContent = \"f(x) = W_eff · x + b_eff (Collapsed)\";\n      } else if (state.activation === 'relu') {\n        insightText.textContent = `ReLU Activation: Creates piecewise-linear hinges (${L} layer(s), ${N} neurons/layer).`;\n        mathExpr.textContent = L === 1 ? \"f(x) = W₂ · ReLU(W₁x + b₁) + b₂\" : `Deep ReLU Network (${L} Hidden Layers)`;\n      } else {\n        insightText.textContent = `Tanh Activation: Smooth non-linear S-curves blend together to approximate physical waves.`;\n        mathExpr.textContent = L === 1 ? \"f(x) = W₂ · tanh(W₁x + b₁) + b₂\" : `Deep Tanh Network (${L} Hidden Layers)`;\n      }\n    }\n\n    function drawPlot() {\n      const w = plotCanvas.width = plotCanvas.clientWidth *    }\n      for (let gy = -1.5; gy <= 1.5; gy += 0.75) {\n        pCtx.beginPath();\n        pCtx.moveTo(50, mapY(gy));\n        pCtx.lineTo(cw - 30, mapY(gy));\n        pCtx.stroke();\n        pCtx.fillStyle = '#64748b';\n        pCtx.font = '12px monospace';\n        pCtx.fillText(gy.toFixed(1), 12, mapY(gy) + 4);\n      }\n\n      pCtx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';\n      pCtx.lineWidth = 3;\n      pCtx.setLineDash([6, 6]);\n      pCtx.beginPath();\n      for (let i = 0; i <= 200; i++) {\n        const x = -3 + (6 * i) / 200;\n        const px = mapX(x);\n        const py = mapY(trueFunc(x));\n        if (i === 0) pCtx.moveTo(px, py);\n        else pCtx.lineTo(px, py);\n      }\n      pCtx.stroke();\n      pCtx.setLineDash([]);\n\n      pCtx.strokeStyle = '#f97316';\n      pCtx.lineWidth = 4;\n      pCtx.beginPath();\n      for (let i = 0; i <= 200; i++) {\n        const x = -3 + (6 * i) / 200;\n        const px = mapX(x);\n        const py = mapY(computeApproximation(x, state.layers, state.neurons, state.activation));\n        if (i === 0) pCtx.moveTo(px, py);\n        else pCtx.lineTo(px, py);\n      }\n      pCtx.stroke();\n    }\n\n    function drawNetwork() {\n      const w = netCanvas.width = netCanvas.clientWidth * window.devicePixelRatio;\n      const h = netCanvas.height = netCanvas.clientHeight * window.devicePixelRatio;\n      nCtx.scale(window.devicePixelRatio, window.devicePixelRatio);\n      const cw = netCanvas.clientWidth;\n      const ch = netCanvas.clientHeight;\n\n      nCtx.clearRect(0, 0, cw, ch);\n\n      const   }\n        colPositions.push(nodes);\n      });\n\n      nCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28)';\n      nCtx.lineWidth = 1.2;\n      for (let c = 0; c < colPositions.length - 1; c++) {\n
